Bundled upstream source snapshot, version 0.43.01:
rapfi-source.tar.gz
https://github.com/dotb1ue/rapfi/tree/f6f05b2e66bafea930ac5802f544a35547fc70ce
This is the last upstream commit before the distribution timestamp, with the
matching version. Bit-for-bit reproducibility of the upstream binary has not
been established. No changes to the engine JS or WASM binary were made.

Network submodule for that source:
https://github.com/dotb1ue/rapfi-networks/tree/918b757a129258e9e765f77fe17d507c2bb1a60b
All the network/config bytes in the official rapfi.data are provided locally
as weights-0.bin, weights-1.bin, weights-2.bin, concatenated in that order.
The worker passes these original bytes through getPreloadedPackage.

Building upstream: see Readme.md and Rapfi/CMakeLists.txt in source archive.
Use Emscripten, NO_COMMAND_MODULES=ON, NO_MULTI_THREADING=ON,
USE_WASM_SIMD=ON and the corresponding Networks files.
The application wrapper worker.js and engine-client.js are included as source.
